¹⁶ "How beautiful you are, my beloved, how delightful! Our bed is a bed of green. ¹⁷ The beams of our house are cedar; our rafters are fir."

¹⁶ His mouth is sweetness itself; he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem."
